name: swapy-handle
title: Swapy Handle Bento Grid
description: Six flat-colour feature tiles of different widths form a tight grid, each showing an emoji, a short claim and a dotted grip. Dragging a grip lifts the tile, and dropping it on another swaps their places.
use: A features block should feel playful and let visitors shuffle the tiles for fun.
avoid: Every colour, emoji and width is fixed in the file, and the new order is only logged, never saved.
a11y: Dragging is pointer only, and the emoji titles are plain text with no role or keyboard alternative. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Six saturated tiles in blue, pink, green, yellow, purple and cyan packed into a twelve-column grid, each with a faint dotted grip at its top left. A black emoji and a short bold title sit centred in each card.
behaves: Pulling a grip frees its tile and marks the slots it passes as drop targets; releasing on a slot swaps the two cards and every tile snaps back to the same fixed height. The reordered map is printed to the console and lasts only until reload.
customise: No props: the six slogans, emoji and colour classes sit in the items array in the file, and the drag config and grid gap are set in the source.
weight: light: Six static colour tiles and a drag handler that only runs during a move.
